decisions.reason: A low-cost thermoforming consumable that fits the core dental lab range, and with no evidence of failure since 2019, keeping the option open costs little.
The PETG blank is a cheap-to-carry standard material in an established thermoforming portfolio with steady lab demand, so dropping it would release almost no resources.
The contrast spray still supports the firm's growing digital intraoral scanning workflows, although newer scanners need less powdering, so it remains a modest strategic option to hold for now.
Custom earmolds run on the firm's existing custom-device and digital manufacturing base for hearing-care retailers, so carrying cost stays low while their value is still being proven.
Custom hearing protection shares the same production base and has occupational market potential that is not yet resolved, so the option stays open at little cost.
